advice_en: Your crops are on track for a normal harvest. Keep farming as usual.
advice_tn: Dijalo tsa gago di tla nna le thobo e e tlwaelegileng. Tswelelang lo lema jaaka lo tlwaetse.

advice_en: Your harvest may be smaller than usual this season. Save water where you can and ask your agricultural extension officer for advice.
advice_tn: Thobo ya gago e ka nna ya bo e le nnye go feta ka tlwaelo mo setlheng seno. Boloka metsi fa o ka kgonang teng mme o kope mogakolodi wa gago wa tsa temothuo gore a go gakolole.

advice_en: Your harvest is expected to be much smaller than usual. Contact your agricultural extension officer as soon as possible.
advice_tn: Go solofetswe gore thobo ya gago e nne potlana thata go na le jaaka go tlwaelegile. Ikgolaganye le motlhankedi wa gago wa thuso ya temothuo ka bonako jo bo kgonegang.

advice_en: This animal looks healthy. No action is needed.
advice_tn: Phologolo eno e lebega e itekanetse. Ga go tlhokege gore o tseye kgato epe.

advice_en: Observe the animal closely and check for changes in health, feeding and behaviour.
advice_tn: Ela tlhoko phologolo mme o lekole diphetogo mo botsogong le mo maitsholong a yone.

advice_en: Check the animal's location and confirm that it is safe and accounted for.
advice_tn: Netefatsa lefelo la phologolo mme o tlhomamise gore e babalesegile.

advice_en: Check the animal promptly and contact a veterinary professional if the signs persist.
advice_tn: Tlhatlhoba phologolo ka bonako, mme o ikgolaganye le ngaka ya diphologolo fa matshwao a tswelela.

advice_en: This animal has been far from its herd for several days. Look for it today and report it to the police if it is missing.
advice_tn: Phologolo eno ga e bolo go nna kgakala le letsomane la yone ka malatsi a le mmalwa. E batle gompieno mme o e begele mapodise fa e ka tswa e nyeletse.

advice_en: Several animals in this area show signs of illness at the same time. Please inspect the herd soon and keep sick animals away from healthy ones.
advice_tn: Diphologolo di le mmalwa mo lefelong leno di bontsha matshwao a bolwetse ka nako e le nngwe. Tsweetswee tlhatlhoba motlhape ka bonako mme o beye diphologolo tse di lwalang kgakala le tse di itekanetseng.
